comparison.objective: Clamp a cake pan and plate together, invert them, deposit the cake, and remove the pan; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-659 tests two-sided whole-stack clamping, coordinated inversion, support placement, and separation; the candidate tests fine tool seating, torque coupling, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-659 requires an inverted cake centred on a plate and the pan removed; the candidate requires a precise retained angle over repeated actuation with secured nuts.
comparison.reason: Coordinated inversion of loose stacked bodies and mechanical stop calibration are different tested abilities.
